hypotheses.Z0_all_144_edges_are_exact: All 144 suffix layer-head edges match direct gradients at every site with cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02.
hypotheses.Z1_frozen_top72_replication: The previously frozen top-72 edges reach median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and 10th percentile at least 0.75 at every distance.
hypotheses.Z2_frozen_top48_is_useful: Top-48 reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.75 at every distance.
hypotheses.Z3_top32_remains_insufficient: Top-32 remains below 0.80 median gradient cosine at at least two distances.
hypotheses.Z4_top72_beats_random: Top-72 exceeds matched-random p95 median cosine by at least 0.15 at every distance.
hypotheses.Z5_half_the_edges_are_sufficient: The first frozen budget reaching median cosine 0.90 is at most 72 at every distance.
hypotheses.Z6_top72_is_causally_directional: Top-72 selected Layer-1 coalitions have positive finite effect in at least 90% of examples at every distance.
hypotheses.Z7_ordering_is_frozen: The ranking is read unchanged from the failed-count artifact and no new evaluation outcome affects it.
